```{r subset cells}

# Subset control microglia
seurat_ctrl <- subset(seurat, subset = sample %in% c("MG-d3-ctrl", "MG-d15-ctrl", "MG-d30-ctrl", "MG-d58-ctrl")) %>%
        subset(subset = celltype %in% c("remodelling microglia", "inflammatory microglia", "resting microglia", "lipid associated microglia", "proliferating microglia")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000)
VariableFeatures(seurat_ctrl) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(seurat_ctrl), unlist(cc.genes))
seurat_ctrl <- CellCycleScoring(seurat_ctrl,
                                  s.features = cc.genes$s.genes,
                                  g2m.features = cc.genes$g2m.genes,
                                  set.ident = TRUE)
seurat_ctrl <- ScaleData(seurat_ctrl, vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"))
seurat_ctrl <- RunPCA(seurat_ctrl) %>% 
        RunUMAP(reduction="css", dims=1:ncol(Embeddings(seurat_ctrl,"css")), reduction.name="umap_css", reduction.key="UMAPCSS_", seed = 46)


# Subset cocultured microglia
seurat_cocul <- subset(seurat, subset = sample %in% c("MG-d3-cocul", "MG-d15-cocul", "MG-d30-cocul", "MG-d58-cocul")) %>%
        subset(subset = celltype %in% c("remodelling microglia", "inflammatory microglia", "resting microglia", "lipid associated microglia", "proliferating microglia")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000)
VariableFeatures(seurat_cocul) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(seurat_cocul), unlist(cc.genes))
seurat_cocul <- CellCycleScoring(seurat_cocul,
                                  s.features = cc.genes$s.genes,
                                  g2m.features = cc.genes$g2m.genes,
                                  set.ident = TRUE)
seurat_cocul <- ScaleData(seurat_cocul, vars.to.regress = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"))
seurat_cocul <- RunPCA(seurat_cocul) %>% 
        RunUMAP(reduction="css", dims=1:ncol(Embeddings(seurat_cocul,"css")), reduction.name="umap_css", reduction.key="UMAPCSS_", seed = 46)

```

```{r run diffusion map}

# Load the destiny package
library(destiny)

# Run destiny on control
dm_ctrl <- DiffusionMap(Embeddings(seurat_ctrl, "pca")[,1:20])
dpt_ctrl <- DPT(dm_ctrl)
seurat_ctrl$dpt <- rank(-dpt_ctrl$dpt)

# Run destiny on coculture
dm_cocul <- DiffusionMap(Embeddings(seurat_cocul, "pca")[,1:20])
dpt_cocul <- DPT(dm_cocul)
seurat_cocul$dpt <- rank(-dpt_cocul$dpt)

FeaturePlot(seurat_ctrl, "dpt", reduction = "umap_css", cols = viridis_pal(option = "B")(30), order = T, pt.size = 0.4) & NoAxes()
FeaturePlot(seurat_ctrl, "dpt", reduction = "pca", cols = viridis_pal(option = "B")(30), order = T, pt.size = 0.4) & NoAxes()

FeaturePlot(seurat_cocul, "dpt", reduction = "umap_css", cols = viridis_pal(option = "B")(30), order = T, pt.size = 0.4) & NoAxes()
FeaturePlot(seurat_cocul, "dpt", reduction = "pca", cols = viridis_pal(option = "B")(30), order = T, pt.size = 0.4) & NoAxes()


```

```{r dtw psudotime alignment function}

# install.packages("pdist")
# install.packages("cobs")

# alignment given expression matrix and pseudotimes of cells in reference trajectory and query trajectories
align_pt_traj <- function(expr_ref, pt_ref, expr_query, pt_query, # data input
		num_breaks_ref = 50, num_breaks_query = num_breaks_ref, dist_method = c("cor", "eucl"), degree = 1, # dtw alignment parameters
		ref_name = "ref", query_name = "query", mode = c("global", "fixed_start", "fixed_end", "partial"), rev = FALSE, # dtw alignment parameters
		nknots_cobs = 20){ # cobs parameters
	require(pdist)
	require(cobs)
	dist_method <- match.arg(dist_method)
	mode <- match.arg(mode)
	
	average_ref <- t(apply(expr_ref, 1, function(e) tapply(e, ceiling(pt_ref * num_breaks_ref), mean)))
	average_query <- t(apply(expr_query, 1, function(e) tapply(e, ceiling(pt_query * num_breaks_query), mean)))

	average_diff <- NULL
	if (dist_method == "cor"){
		average_diff <- 1-cor(average_query, average_ref)
	} else if (dist_method == "eucl"){
		average_diff <- as.matrix(pdist::pdist(t(average_query), t(average_ref)))
	}

	if (degree > 1)
		average_diff <- average_diff ^ degree
	
	alignment <- align_diff(average_diff, ref_name = ref_name, query_name = query_name, mode = mode, rev = rev)
	pointwise_constrain <- NULL
	if (mode == "global"){
		pointwise_constrain <- rbind(c(0,0,0), c(0,1,1))
	} else if (mode == "fixed_start"){
		pointwise_constrain <- rbind(c(0,0,0))
	} else if (mode == "fixed_end"){
		pointwise_constrain <- rbind(c(0,1,1))
	}
	model <- cobs(x = c(0,alignment$alignment[,1]) / num_breaks_query,
				  y = c(0,alignment$alignment[,2]) / num_breaks_ref,
				  constraint= "increase", pointwise=pointwise_constrain, nknots=nknots_cobs)
	
	pt_query_aligned <- predict(model, pt_query)[,2]
	res <- list(alignment = alignment, model = model, pt_query_aligned = pt_query_aligned)
	return(res)
}

```

```{r dtw pseudoptime alignment}

# generate a vector with common variable features
common_vf <- intersect(VariableFeatures(seurat_ctrl), VariableFeatures(seurat_cocul))

# Function from Kanton et al. 2019, https://github.com/quadbiolab/primate_cerebral_organoids/blob/master/pt_alignment.r
aligned_pt <- align_pt_traj_with_ref(expr_ref = seurat_ctrl@assays$RNA@data[common_vf,], 
              pt_ref = rank(-dpt_ctrl$dpt), 
              expr_query = seurat_cocul@assays$RNA@data[common_vf,], 
              pt_query = rank(-dpt_cocul$dpt),
		          dist_method = c("spearman"), 
	            degree = 1,
		          ref_name = "ref", 
		          query_name = "query", 
		          mode = c("fixed_start"), 
		          rev = FALSE,
		          nknots_cobs = 20)

```

```{r}

ranked_aligned_pt <- rank(c(setNames(rank(-dpt_ctrl$dpt), colnames(seurat_ctrl)), setNames(aligned_pt$pt_query_aligned, colnames(seurat_cocul)))[colnames(seurat_cocul)])

dist(rbind(ranked_aligned_pt, rank(dpt_ctrl)))

library(gplots)
heatmap.2(aligned_pt$alignment$diff_mat, col=bluered_colscheme(30), trace="none",Rowv=NA, Colv=NA,dendrogram="none",scale="none", key=F,keysize=0.5)
```
